models.name: youtube__video_report
models.description: Each record represents the daily aggregation of your YouTube video performance.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The date the video was viewed

columns.name: video_id
columns.description: Unique ID of the video

columns.name: channel_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the video channel

columns.name: video_title
columns.description: Title of the video

columns.name: video_description
columns.description: Description of the video

columns.name: channel_title
columns.description: Title of the channel

columns.name: video_published_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the video was published

columns.name: average_view_duration_percentage
columns.description: Average duration of views represented as a percent of the entire length of the video, weighted by the number of views.

columns.name: average_view_duration_seconds
columns.description: Average duration of views for the video in seconds, weighted by the number of views.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: Total number of comment posted on the video

columns.name: dislikes
columns.description: Total number of dislikes attributed to the video

columns.name: likes
columns.description: Total number of likes attributed to the video

columns.name: shares
columns.description: Total number of times the video was shared

columns.name: subscribers_gained
columns.description: Total subscribers gained from the video

columns.name: subscribers_lost
columns.description: Total subscribers lost from the video

columns.name: views
columns.description: Total number of views the video received

columns.name: watch_time_minutes
columns.description: Total watch time in minutes the video received

columns.name: video_duration_seconds
columns.description: The total duration of the video in seconds

models.name: youtube__age_demographics_pivot
models.description: Each record represents a daily video view percentage with the age ranges pivoted out for quicker analysis.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The date the video was viewed

columns.name: video_id
columns.description: Unique ID of the video

columns.name: video_title
columns.description: Title of the video

columns.name: video_description
columns.description: Description of the video

columns.name: video_published_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the video was published

columns.name: channel_title
columns.description: The channel title

columns.name: AGE_18_24_view_percentage
columns.description: Total number of views percent attributed to the age range 18 - 24 years old

columns.name: AGE_65__view_percentage
columns.description: Total number of views percent attributed to the age range 65 years and older

columns.name: AGE_13_17_view_percentage
columns.description: Total number of views percent attributed to the age range 13 - 17 years old

models.name: youtube__demographics_report
models.description: Each record represents a daily video view percentage by gender, age, and country.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The date the video was viewed

columns.name: video_id
columns.description: Unique ID of the video

columns.name: video_title
columns.description: Title of the video

columns.name: video_description
columns.description: Description of the video

columns.name: channel_title
columns.description: The channel title

columns.name: video_published_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the video was published

columns.name: age_group
columns.description: The age group the individual. Ranges follow the format of 'AGE_[min age]_[max age]'

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Country code where the individual who watched the video is located

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender of the user who watched the video. Either 'MALE', 'FEMALE', or 'GENDER_OTHER'

columns.name: views_percentage
columns.description: Total percent of views the user makes up for the video
